description: Ministry of Water Supply and Estate Infrastructure Development - Amended Extra Gazette No.2343/28 dated 2nd August 2023, in Respeet of  the Water tariffs with Effect From 01 August 2023.
reasoning: This gazette contains a legal notice under Section 84 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Law No. 02 of 1974, revising water tariffs and establishing regulatory frameworks for different consumer categories. While it includes a minister's name and signature, this is ministerial authentication of a regulatory action rather than a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment. The core content is regulatory in nature, establishing new tariff structures and compliance requirements for water supply services.
